title: Thirty-day plan to win a first logistics customer
scenario:
TOPIC: Turn a logistics automation idea into a first customer in 30 days
A solo founder with a full-time job has 15 focused hours per week, basic no-code skills, ₹40,000, and no audience. The offer would automate proof-of-delivery follow-up for small trucking fleets. Create a 30-day execution plan to reach one paying pilot. Work backwards from the deadline, include customer contact in week one, give every step one owner and a definition of done, surface dependencies and lead times with realistic buffers, set weekly checkpoint targets, define numeric kill criteria with dates, and name the top execution risk with mitigation.

bad_signs.name: generic execution advice
bad_signs.pattern: start with market research.*build.*market|stay focused and execute

improvement_suggestions: Fit the workload to the founder's actual availability.
Put contact with prospective fleet operators at the beginning.
Make failure visible early enough to change course.
